title: Brooklyn Beckham and Nicola Peltz Mark Vow Renewal Anniversary with Sweet Tributes Amid Family Estrangement
text:
Brooklyn Beckham and Nicola Peltz celebrate their vow renewal anniversary with social media tributes, while still estranged from his parents.
Brooklyn Beckham and Nicola Peltz have once again celebrated their wedding anniversary, but this time it was for their elaborate vow renewal that took place in August 2025, a ceremony that conspicuously excluded Brooklyn's estranged family.
The couple took to Instagram on Tuesday to mark the occasion with gushing posts, with Brooklyn referring to his wife as his 'absolute princess' and expressing his eternal love. This public display of affection comes just days after the pair narrowly missed an encounter with Brooklyn's parents, David and Victoria Beckham, while vacationing in the South of France.
The vow renewal was initially intended to create new, happy memories for the couple, as Brooklyn revealed in a bombshell statement earlier in the year. He detailed the anxiety and embarrassment he felt during their original wedding in April 2022, accusing his mother, Victoria, of hijacking his first dance and even calling him 'evil' over seating arrangements.
The renewal, held in New York's Westchester County, saw a guest list that was noticeably one-sided, with none of the Beckham family in attendance. Instead, the festivities were filled with friends and acquaintances Brooklyn has made since his relationship with Nicola began. Brooklyn's statement, which was released in January, painted a picture of a fraught wedding planning process.
He explained that the decision to renew their vows was driven by a desire to replace the negative memories of their first wedding with joy and happiness. He recounted how his family told him that Nicola was 'not blood' and 'not family' the night before the wedding, and how his mother danced 'very inappropriately' with him in front of 500 guests, making him feel 'uncomfortable and humiliated'.
These revelations have deepened the rift between Brooklyn and his parents, which has been a topic of intense media scrutiny. The recent holiday in France highlighted the ongoing distance between the couple and the Beckham family. Brooklyn and Nicola were staying on a yacht owned by Elton John, who is Brooklyn's godfather, near Nice, while David and Victoria were anchored in St Tropez, approximately 75 miles away.
This was the closest the family has been in months, yet they did not meet. The proximity was noted by observers, adding another layer to the ongoing family saga. For Brooklyn and Nicola, however, this time was about celebrating their love and commitment. As they marked their vow renewal anniversary, both Brooklyn and Nicola shared heartfelt messages online.
Nicola posted 'happy anniversary my love you make life so beautiful. thank you for being the most amazing husband i could ever dream of'. These tributes stand in stark contrast to the earlier anniversary in April, when Brooklyn opted to post only a temporary Instagram story with white roses, perhaps reflecting the different significance he places on the two events.
The couple's decision to publicly celebrate their renewal, while excluding his family, sends a clear message about their priorities and the state of their relationships. The drama surrounding the Beckham family continues to be a tabloid fixture, with Brooklyn's statements and actions keeping the story alive. With each anniversary and public gesture, the couple reinforces their narrative of healing and moving forward without the involvement of Brooklyn's parents.
Whether this rift will ever be mended remains uncertain, but for now, Brooklyn and Nicola are focused on building their own life together, celebrating their love in their own way, and creating memories that are entirely their own
